description: Paris - Référentiel géographique pour les données trafic issues des capteurs permanents is a dataset listed in Plateforme open data de la Région Île-de-France, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Ville de Paris. Référentiel géographique (arcs du réseau) pour les données trafic issues des capteurs permanents. Ce jeu de données contient le référentiel de la disposition des arcs du réseau renseigné, support des données des capteurs permanents du trafic routier, projection en EPSG:2154. La jointure avec les données de trafic doit se faire par l'attribut i uac. Coverage: Île-de-France. The portal files it under Déplacements - transports. Its keywords are Trafic, Circulation, Géolocalisation. The portal shows 3,739 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2019-09-21 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODbL-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-iledefrance-fr-portal.
